label: Grades K-2
notes: Teacher led on projector or smartboard; huge visuals; read-aloud; nothing a child must read alone
blurb: Made for the projector or smartboard. Big pictures, recorded voices and whole-class play, with nothing a child has to read alone.

label: Grades 3-5
notes: Colorful; light game elements; students may drive
blurb: Lead it from the front or hand it to students. Clear steps, short rounds and pictures that carry the reading.

label: Grades 6-8
notes: Cleaner; scores and streaks; smaller celebrations
blurb: Students work on their own devices. Explore modes for discovery, practice modes with scores to beat.

label: Grades 9-12
blurb: Tools that work like the real thing: simulators, data and models that students run and question.
